author: MrHandyman
quote: I pity the fools who choose to spend money on this. There are no redeeming qualities here. Its like watching paint dry in a ‘product’ that is most definitely a PsyOp

author: MrHandyman
quote: As a 14 year old who bought a ps3 back in the day just to play god of war 3 I could not be less proud in calling this game a masterpiece and the finest ps exclusive I have ever played. Barlog and team took me back to when I was 14 years old and made me have the experience of a kid again.

author: MrHandyman
quote: Greatest game I have ever played in my life! Every encounter and interaction in this world is so finely crafted it’s baffling. We are in next gen BABY!

author: MrHandyman
quote: I do not like propoganda in my games. Ive seen the gameplay walkthrough and this is the worst story i have ever seen in a videogame. It is a disgrace to the gaming industry and the game journalists who are rating this a 10 are a disgrace too. The gameplay might be fine but the story is so bad and disrespectful it is heartbreaking for those of us who are fans of the first game.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
